A deterministic stamp that a focus name filed an 8-K Item 2.02 today, and that digest numbers predate that period, would stop the next run from citing a stale quarter as current.

The digest still publishes a 58.8% YoY revenue figure for ABNB against the company's own 17% in the 2026-08-06 shareholder letter (Q2 2026 $3.608B vs Q2 2025 $3.096B in sec_filings) — the same class of digest-vs-source error already flagged on DXCM.
